title: Fulham vs Chelsea closes Premier League Matchweek 1
excerpt: The West London derby at Craven Cottage is Monday's headline Premier League fixture, with Chelsea beginning their league campaign under Xabi Alonso.
content: Fulham host Chelsea on Monday night to complete the opening Premier League matchweek.
Confirmed lineups, Chelsea's rebuilt squad and Fulham's home structure are the main forecasting inputs.

title: Norris wins Dutch Grand Prix as Antonelli extends championship lead
excerpt: Lando Norris won at Zandvoort ahead of Kimi Antonelli and George Russell, while Antonelli increased his lead at the top of the drivers' standings.
content: Norris converted pole position into victory after a strategic fight at Zandvoort.
Antonelli finished second and Russell third, giving Mercedes a double podium.

title: Liverpool rescue 2-2 draw at Newcastle with 99th-minute penalty
excerpt: Newcastle led twice at St James' Park, but Liverpool salvaged a dramatic draw deep into stoppage time.
content: Newcastle and Liverpool drew 2-2 in one of the opening weekend's most dramatic matches.
The late equaliser underlined the volatility of early-season game states.

title: Gvardiol gives Manchester City late 2-1 win over Bournemouth
excerpt: Manchester City overturned a deficit with Marc Guehi equalising before Josko Gvardiol struck in stoppage time.
content: Manchester City opened the campaign with a dramatic 2-1 home win over Bournemouth.
Late-game control and substitutions became decisive after Bournemouth had led for most of the match.

title: Brighton beat Aston Villa 4-0 and jump to the top of the early table
excerpt: Brighton scored four times before the interval and opened the season with the biggest winning margin of the weekend so far.
content: Brighton defeated Aston Villa 4-0 at the Amex.
The result puts Brighton top of the early standings on goal difference before Fulham and Chelsea play on Monday.

title: US Open singles qualifying starts Monday in New York
excerpt: Men's and women's singles qualifying begins on August 24, with mixed doubles qualifying also on the Fan Week schedule.
content: US Open Fan Week moves into singles qualifying on Monday.
The main singles draw begins on August 30.

title: Winston-Salem Open continues as final ATP tune-up before US Open
excerpt: The ATP 250 main draw continues Monday, with players balancing ranking points against recovery before New York.
content: Winston-Salem runs from August 23 to 29 on outdoor hard courts.
Main-draw sessions on Monday begin at 2 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. local time.

title: Vuelta a España moves into Stage 3
excerpt: Monday's cycling focus shifts to Stage 3, with general-classification positioning and breakaway timing becoming the main live variables.
content: Stage 3 of the Vuelta a España is part of Monday's global sports schedule.
Early Grand Tour stages can create sharp shifts in breakaway and GC strategy.
